caption: The drawing depicts a single rusted metal object composed of two main parts: an upper cylindrical container and a broad, shallow dish-like base connected by a central supporting column. The cylinder has three protruding sections: two on either side near the top, each with visible white paper stuffed inside or emerging from jagged openings, and a curved handle attached to one side near the bottom. The entire object displays a rusty, orange-brown color with mottled gray patches, indicating corrosion and wear. The cylindrical container also has several holes and irregular edges, further suggesting damage or decay. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background, and the artist's signature, "Margaret Golden," is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Grease Lamp
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
